answer: Sybil resistance is a non-transferable work bond. A new key starts with an empty garden and earns only after peers echo a paragraph that has never appeared before. Pasting the same walnut of prose under another key is rejected by answer-hash uniqueness, so a farmer cannot amortize one text across many identities. Each fake therefore costs a fresh composition plus a vesting delay before any payout, and that cost rises one-for-one with the number of keys.
